profile.name: CoolLED pE系列显微镜LED照明控制器
profile.name_en: CoolLED pE Series Microscope LED Illumination Controller
profile.description: 这是一类用于显微镜的多通道LED照明控制器与光源系统，常见于荧光显微成像。设备可提供多个独立波段通道（如A到H），用于激发不同荧光染料，并支持通道选择、开关和TTL触发控制。
profile.description_en: A multi-channel LED illumination controller and light source system for microscopes, commonly used in fluorescence imaging. It provides multiple independent wavelength channels (such as A to H) for exciting different fluorophores, with channel selection, on/off control, and TTL triggering.
